review_text: Not sure what to expect from this place. Ambience is fine, but no food. Beverages are just ok. Not value for money.

Honestly, the vibe here is so chilled, but what really made the visit was the service. Samay was on top of it—he caught a small detail in my order I usually have to repeat twice, and he did it with a smile. It’s those little things that make a place feel like more than just a quick stop. Definitely coming back.
